description: Calibration parameters whose movement across their own declared range reorders the system's conclusions. A guess is allowed here only when the ordering survives it, so these are the numbers that need measuring rather than guessing. The list may shrink and may not grow: a new entry means a conclusion has become dependent on a number nobody has measured.

notes.interiority.receptor.recycling_rate: Added 2026-09-07, and it was revealed rather than introduced. The third arm of the same receptor adaptation whose other two are already here. Its sensitivity was invisible while interiority.tendency_conflict was pinned at 1.0 — normalised entropy over the ACTIVE tendencies, so two equally-weighted readinesses scored the ceiling and self.coherence was a constant zero. With the conflict measured against the whole vocabulary the coherence varies, and this rate reorders conclusions through it. Nothing here got worse; a dependency that already existed stopped being hidden by a constant.
